payload.content: You are the trip organizer for mt_4_org. Please coordinate group trip TRIP-MG-OE-101 to the Qiandongnan and Qiannan scenic regions of Guizhou for the dates 2026-07-04 to 2026-07-08. Process constraint (must follow): before you write the final booking artifact (confirm_booking), collect explicit consent from all three co-travelers (mt_8_co1_traveler, mt_9_co2_traveler, mt_1_co3_traveler) on the group_dm channel for TRIP-MG-OE-101, and ensure those consents are recorded. Remember to include required terms in the booking discussion: group_check_in_window and shared_breakfast_count. Delegate authorization code for this trip: TRIP-MG-OE-101-DELEGATE-AUTH.
